title: Grant for Companies to Offset Cost of Hiring Temporary Staff for Pregnant Employees
what_it_is: Grant for Companies to Offset Cost of Hiring Temporary Staff for Pregnant Employees

sections.label: Work-Life Grant for companies
sections.summary: The Work-Life Grant provides up to $160,000 over four years per company to encourage companies to implement FWAs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To encourage companies to implement FWAs, we provide the Work-Life Grant of up to $160,000 over four years per company.

sections.label: Double robotics technology solution
sections.summary: They used the Work-Life Grant to put in place a system known as double robotics technology.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, they were creative and they found an alternative solution.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: They took advantage of the Work-Life Grant and they put in place a system that is known as double robotics technology.

sections.label: Work-Life Grant sign-ups support
sections.summary: Support is offered if it makes sense for employees and business, and over a thousand companies have signed up since the Work-Life Grant launched.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If it seems to make sense to what they are hoping that it would achieve for their employees as well as for their business, then we would like to be able to support it.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: I would also like to share with Mr Louis Ng that since the Work-Life Grant was launched, we have had well over a thousand companies which have signed up.

sections.label: MOM study party involvement
sections.summary: MOM is happy to work with any party that would like to get involved in the study.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If there is a party that would like to get involved in the study, MOM is happy to work with this party to see how we can support it.
